# Lenis

`lenis-1.3.26.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of Lenis 1.3.26.

Source: https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.26/dist/lenis.min.js
Documentation: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
License: MIT, included in `LENIS-LICENSE.txt`.

Served locally to work with the site's existing Content Security Policy. No runtime CDN request is required.
